crossRefs.note: When they tell you, “Consult with those who have familiar spirits and with the wizards, who chirp and who mutter,”…
who frustrates the signs of the liars, and makes diviners mad; who turns wise men backward, and makes their knowledge…
But these two things will come to you in a moment in one day, the loss of children and widowhood. They will come on you…
Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed…

translations.web: They listened to him, because for a long time he had amazed them with his sorceries.
translations.bsb: They paid close attention to him because he had astounded them for a long time with his sorcery.
translations.kjv: And to him they had regard, because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries.
translations.asv: And they gave heed to him, because that of long time he had amazed them with his sorceries.
